verdicts.title: Cumulative Probability of Blast Fragmentation Effect
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper presents formulae for calculation of cumulative probability of effect made by blast fragments. Analysis with Mott distribution, discrete fragment enumeration, spatial non-uniformity, numerical issues, and a generalisation for a set of effects are also discussed.
